title: Unpaid Wayfare Rides Fares: Payment With a Newly Added Payment Method
content:
## Rule

On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** a rider whose fare charge failed to collect and who wants to settle it pays it themselves with a newly added payment method.

The rider pays the unpaid-fare payment amount with a newly added payment method as one settlement entry against the fare charge, which settles the unpaid fare in part when an amount is held out.

An amount held out of the payment against a submitted fare review stays unpaid on the fare charge without blocking new requests until the fare review team decides it; any other unpaid amount still blocks new requests until it is settled.

## Conditions on fixing the payment amount

A payment toward an unpaid fare is not taken until the fare charge carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving toll not incurred as its reason wherever a toll was charged on a trip whose fare was recalculated without any rider route change.

The unpaid-fare payment amount is fixed only after a fare recalculated without any rider route change carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving route inefficiency as its reason.

The unpaid-fare payment amount is not fixed before any detour delay on a trip whose fare was recalculated without a rider route change stands as a submitted fare review giving route inefficiency as its reason.

## What remains unpaid after the payment

| Part of the unpaid fare | After the payment |
|---|---|
| The unpaid-fare payment amount | paid by the rider with the newly added payment method, as one settlement entry against the fare charge |
| An amount held out against a submitted fare review | stays unpaid on the fare charge; does not block new requests until the fare review team decides it |
| Any other unpaid amount | blocks new requests until it is settled |

## The payment — `pay_unpaid_fare_new_card_1dc475f0`

**Capability.** Pays toward a fare that failed to collect, with a payment method newly added in the app: an amount toward one unpaid fare charge of the rider's trip, using the card they have just added. One call charges that card and writes one settlement entry of the new-payment-method kind against the unpaid fare charge, dated today, for the amount given; the trip's unpaid amount drops by that amount. The rider sees the payment confirmation and the trip's remaining unpaid amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is the rider's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_unpaid_fare_new_card_1dc475f0` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, which hands it over to the rider, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, entering the reference numbers and the amount the agent reads out to them.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trip_id` | the trip reference number of the trip with the unpaid fare, as read out by the agent from the trip lookup | identifier |
| `original_charge_id` | the charge reference number of the unpaid fare charge, as read out by the agent from the trip charge lookup | identifier |
| `payment_amount` | the amount paid with the new card | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the entry records it as a negative movement on the unpaid balance |

**Return.** A receipt with `trip_charge_id` (reference number of the new settlement entry), `trip_id`, `original_charge_id` (the unpaid fare charge), `amount` (signed entry amount in USD, negative, 2 decimal places), `outstanding_amount` (the trip's unpaid amount left after the payment, USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`. A status of "paid" means the payment went through.
